direct_checks: Methods, results, conclusions, disclosures, funding, units and statistical qualifications compared with the source.
P0–P100 WPC formulation fractions kept distinct from pure protein fractions; De and PCR denominators explained.
Adhesive/cohesive scraper levels kept distinct from actual mixed failure mechanisms. Force, stress and work retain their units.
P100 temperature/stiffness inconsistency retained and explained beside Table 2; no silent change to authors’ claim.
Original equation (1) proportional symbol and equation (2) time bounds with dx preserved with a separate note.
Table 3 contains one F/p dataset despite mentioning both De and PCR; editorial note explains visible scope.
Native figures remain byte-identical. Figure 3 panels b/c correctly identify 20/40 °C force curves, not Young modulus; Figure 2 reading key matches actual labels.
Figure 5 source caption says force-time while plotted x-axis is displacement; separate reading key describes the plotted axes.
All references retained in English; line-break extraction artifacts normalised in reformatted HTML only.
Separate supplement was blocked at source; SI1/SI2 references retained, supplement explicitly excluded from translated and archived main article scope.
